svg.title: Key direction: encryption and signing
svg.desc: CONFIDENTIALITY: message for Bob. Alice encrypts with Bob public key. Bob decrypts with Bob private key. SIGNATURE: content and Alice key. Alice signs with Alice private key. Bob verifies with Alice public key. Signing does not hide content. Authenticate the public key separately.

g.text: Alice encrypts with Bob public key
Bob decrypts with Bob private key
Alice signs with Alice private key
Bob verifies with Alice public key
Signing does not hide content. Authenticate the public key separately.
